policies.qual:
(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM (program_versions v
 JOIN program_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = v.id)))
 WHERE ((v.program_id = programs.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM program_assignments a
 WHERE ((a.version_id = program_days.version_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM (program_days d
 JOIN program_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = d.version_id)))
 WHERE ((d.id = day_blocks.day_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM ((day_blocks b
 JOIN program_days d ON ((d.id = b.day_id)))
 JOIN program_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = d.version_id)))
 WHERE ((b.id = block_exercises.block_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM (meal_plan_versions v
 JOIN meal_plan_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = v.id)))
 WHERE ((v.meal_plan_id = meal_plans.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM program_assignments a
 WHERE ((a.version_id = program_versions.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM meal_plan_assignments a
 WHERE ((a.version_id = meal_plan_versions.id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
 FROM (((block_exercises be
 JOIN day_blocks b ON ((b.id = be.block_id)))
 JOIN program_days d ON ((d.id = b.day_id)))
 JOIN program_assignments a ON ((a.version_id = d.version_id)))
 WHERE ((be.id = program_week_overrides.block_exercise_id) AND (a.client_id = auth.uid()))))
